retrievalProfile.description: A classic 80s rock aesthetic featuring a warm-toned, grainy portrait framed by white horizontal bands and topped with extremely tall, thin sans-serif lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male figure with feathered hair, leaning against a textured stucco wall. The image is characterized by a warm, desaturated color palette and a distinct letterbox layout with white borders at the top and bottom. The typography is positioned in the top white band, featuring an extremely high aspect ratio.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a square frame bounded by white horizontal bars
High-contrast shadows against a warm, textured background
Typography aligned to the top-left within the upper white margin
Grainy film texture across the entire photographic area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up, seated and leaning, occupying the lower two-thirds of the central photographic square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the sharp contrast of the white shirt against the dark shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the tall typography in the top left, move down to the subject's face, and follow the diagonal line of the arm toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the white horizontal bands and the textured wall behind the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and tan (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns (shadows and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal range and film grain; high value in the white areas creates a clean frame.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and monochrome

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' has very short horizontal bars
The 'O' is a narrow vertical rectangle with rounded corners
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for impact; secondary text if present should be small, light-weight sans-serif in the bottom margin.
graphicDevices: Thin black rule lines separating the photo from the white bars

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme condensed nature and clean sans-serif lines.
Can achieve the verticality if manually scaled, though weight is heavier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square portrait of a man with 80s feathered hair, wearing a white button-down shirt, leaning against a warm-toned stucco wall with heavy film grain. Add thick white horizontal bands at the top and bottom of the square image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top white band, add the desired text using an ultra-condensed, tall sans-serif font in a dark slate grey, aligned to the left with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the typography extremely tall and narrow?
Are there white bands at the top and bottom?
Does the photo have a warm, grainy 80s aesthetic?
Is the text color a dark neutral rather than pure black?

adjustableVariables: Height of the white border bands
Tracking width of the display text

mustAchieve: Precise alignment of typography within the border

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the photographic area.
Ensure the grain is visible but does not obscure facial features.
Verify the typography is uppercase and ultra-condensed.
Confirm the presence of the thin black divider lines.
